newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster to buy Barefoot lawn care.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster to buy Barefoot lawn care.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP has a definitive agreement to acquire Barefoot Inc., the nation's second-largest lawn care company, in a deal valued at about $230 million, the companies said Thursday.
Barefoot will be merged with ServiceMaster subsidiary TruGreen-ChemLawn, the nation's largest lawn care company.
ServiceMaster said it will launch a tender offer of $16 a share in either cash or stock for Barefoot stock, subject to prior due diligence and other regulatory procedures.
Barefoot's stock rose $2.625 to $15.375 early on Nasdaq. Downers Grove, Ill.-based ServiceMaster was unchanged at $24.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Closing of the deal is contingent upon the participation in the tender offer of at least 75 percent of Barefoot's 14.5 million outstanding shares.

Barefoot, based in Worthington, Ohio, serves over 500,000 customers in 103 metropolitan markets and has more than $125 million in annualized revenues. For the nine months ended Sept. 30, the company had operating income of $21 million.
TruGreen-ChemLawn, with customer revenues of over $630 million, serves 2.5 million customers through over 260 service centres across the country.
